description: This file defines the PublisherService class in a Java Spring Boot application. It provides methods to perform CRUD operations on Publisher entities, interfacing with PublisherRepository. The class is annotated as a Spring Service and uses Lombok annotations for logging and null checks.

classes.name: PublisherService
classes.description: Service class managing CRUD operations for Publisher entities, interfacing with PublisherRepository, and validating publisher data before save.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Publisher by its ID, returns an Optional<Publisher>.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the given Publisher if its name is not empty.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Publisher entities.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of Publisher entities.
